description: Enterprise. Returns Grid map layers as GeoJSON clipped to your boundary (a polygon or a set of parcel ids), so an assistant or GIS can work on a site without pulling public services one by one. Layers: parcels (Appraisal parcels (id, prop_id, county, acres, situs, values, source year). Owner names are not included: use parcel_lookup.); flood_zones (FEMA NFHL flood zones (zone, floodway, BFE).); flood_ble (TWDB/FEMA Base Level Engineering flood extents (10, 1, 0.2 percent chance). An estimate, not the regulatory FIRM.); ble_coverage (Where BLE studies exist: 0.05 degree coverage squares. Outside them, no BLE answer means not studied.); wetlands (USFWS National Wetlands Inventory polygons.); crit_habitat (USFWS critical habitat.); soil_bedrock (SSURGO map units with minimum depth to bedrock (cm), hydrologic group, drainage class.); soil_hazard (SSURGO map units flagged for flooding, ponding or caliche.); soil_restrictions (SSURGO map units with name, hydrologic group, hydric rating and every component restriction (kind, hardness, depth, component share).); washes (Washes and drainage keep-outs (DEM channels by contributing area plus NHD), with buffer used.); streams (NHDPlus HR flowlines with total drainage area (km2), stream order, perennial flag and name.); roads_major (HPMS public roads (functional class, AADT, trucks, lanes, surface).); roads_local (Census TIGER/Line all roads, including local public roads (name, route type, MTFCC).); railroads (Rail lines (owner, subdivision, class, status).); pipelines (Trunk pipelines (operator, system, commodity, diameter).); fiber (Long-haul and metro fiber routes.); water_wells (State water wells (TWDB GWDB and SDR): depth, aquifer, use, yield, TDS.); aquifers (TWDB major and minor aquifers.); utility_ccn (PUCT electric CCN service areas.); osm_substations (OpenStreetMap substations (voltages, operator).) Each layer comes back inline when small and always as a download link (30 minutes). Boundary limit about 150,000 acres; up to 8 layers and 50,000 features per layer per call.

boundary.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon (or a Feature or FeatureCollection of them) in lng/lat, EPSG:4326.

parcel_ids.description: Grid parcel ids to use as the boundary instead (merged). Up to 500.

simplify_m.description: Optional simplification tolerance in meters for polygons and lines (0 = none).

name: layer_clip
title: Grid layers clipped to a boundary (GeoJSON)
